entries.because: Build-time CSS compiler used by Tailwind 4, run unmodified and never shipped to the browser. MPL-2.0 is file-level: obligations arise only if its own files are modified. Pending Jurídico confirmation (docs/pendencias-externas.md).
The per-platform binaries of lightningcss (darwin, linux gnu and musl, windows…), one of which each machine installs. Same review as lightningcss.
The PSF license is permissive (no copyleft); reaches us through js-yaml in dev tooling.
Inter is the design system's typeface. The SIL Open Font License permits embedding and bundling; it only restricts selling the font itself.
The handwritten typeface of the whiteboard (Etapa 4d). Same licence and review as Inter: embedding and bundling are permitted; only selling the font itself is not.
